notes: Dialogs, pickers and menus on the donor idiom: a shared ConfirmDialog kit (GHOST, PRIMARY, DANGER, DialogFooter, ErrorLine) replaces every window.alert and window.confirm in GitChangesPanel, the rail ChangesPanel, TitleBar group delete and NotesView delete; RemoveProjectDialog and SwitchBranchDialog sit on Modal with the kit input and an inline error line instead of an alert; SymbolPicker and FilePicker take the modal recipe (bg-black/40 scrim, rounded-2xl glass, h-7 rounded-lg 13px rows washed on highlight only); GitChangesPanel's commit options and InboxView's project picker are Popovers with menu rows and a Check on the current item; InboxFiltersMenu gets a flat item list with arrow-key navigation, 11px uppercase section labels and h-7 rows; CwdPicker, ModelPicker, AccessPicker, ModelSettings and BranchPicker wash on highlight only and mark the selection with Check 2.25, 11px shortcut and remote labels, disabled at /40; ProjectDialogs teardown boxes become kit Toggles; Lightbox drops the glass blur and rounded-full controls for size-7 rounded-md buttons on a bg-black/40 scrim; ColorPickerPopover loses its card-in-card and takes the kit hex input; AppshotFlyIn sits on LAYER.dialog; menus open 4px under their anchor; modal bodies px-4 py-3 with the footer recipe in SettingsView's delete-thread and EULA modals; animated glass (Modal, Popover, ApprovalToasts) caps at glass-surface--md
